model_observation.scope: Actual omitted model overrides mean inherited session defaults; explicit experimental requests, where present, remain requests. The host does not expose authenticated resolved backend identities.

metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: One unrandomized shared-host execution. Actual final-product primary inspection is partial; some final variants were captured but not personally viewed before handoff. Original combined six-image return export was lost after a host write hang, retained PNGs are intact, and post-boundary image evidence is separately dated. Core checks used programmatic focus setup; uninterrupted keyboard traversal, screen reader, real mobile keyboard, error/retry, other engines and natural-time playback remain unverified. Notebook upstream is archived; local compatibility patches need maintenance. Child request omits final LF. Resolved native model/role identity, tokens, billing and context metrics unavailable.
